_meta.description: Maps a prompt id (used in configs/*.json under `prompts`) to a file under prompts/. Change which prompt the app uses by changing an id in a config - never by editing code. Once a version has been evaluated, do not edit it in place; add the next version here.
_meta.validation: prompts/loader.py checks the declared input_variables against the placeholders actually present in the file, in both directions, and refuses to load a mismatch.

system.v1_persona.description: Extracted byte-for-byte from the original app.py PromptTemplate, including its original indentation, so baseline runs reproduce the deployed bot's behaviour exactly. First-person recruiter-facing persona with an inline 'About Me' paragraph and a long STRICT URL RULES block. 4905 chars.

system.v2_persona.description: Restructured variant, 1889 chars (-62% vs v1). Three deliberate changes: (1) drops the static 'About Me' paragraph, which duplicated the profile_summary chunk already arriving via retrieval and could conflict with it; (2) compresses the URL rules from eight bullets to three sentences; (3) replaces the two worked tone examples with a short voice description. Hypothesis: groundedness and persona adherence hold while prompt tokens and URL-hallucination attempts both fall.

query_expansion.v1.description: LLM-based query rewriting. NOT used by default: retrieval.query_expansion.mode is 'keyword_rules', which needs no prompt. Set mode to 'llm' to activate. Written to resolve follow-up pronouns into standalone queries, which the keyword rules cannot do.

summarizer.v1.description: Condenses older turns so history stays inside the token budget. Ported from app.py's inline summary_prompt, with one deliberate change: the hardcoded '2-3 sentences' became {max_sentences}, wired to memory.summary_max_sentences so it is tunable like every other parameter.
